- The entrance rules now correctly apply between regions
- The existing boss kill logic has been applied to various region entrances and locations to ensure that grinding too much is not necessary for logical progression

- The logic has been ported to RuleBuilder

**Only the APWorld has been changed, so if you have the previous version of the client, you do not need to reinstall the client.**

For setup instructions, refer here: https://github.com/josephwhite/Emerlads-Nodebuster_AP_Mod/blob/dev/docs/setup_en.md

v0.1.0.description:
This is the Beta release of the archipelago mod for Nodebuster.

# New Features!
### UI Features.
* A New Connection Menu.

* Upgrade List. - There is now a form of a tracker inbuilt. When opened it will show you how many items you have received and how many you have not. It also breaks the items up into their different groups.

* Visible Hint Locations. - Adds a border around an upgrade node when an item was hinted for that location.

### New Randomization Options.
* Boss Drops. - Boss drops are now able to be added to the itempool. when you defeat a boss for the first time instead of giving a core it will instead give a randomized item.

* CryptoMine Levels. - Inside the CryptoMine menu you are able to upgrade the speed of which the cryptomine will convert bits to netcoins. This option when enabled will randomize those said levels.

* Progressive Items. - The Rate at which the game scales felt a little off. so with this setting enabled instead of being able to get high levels of upgrades early you will instead upgrade them progressively.

* Death Link actually works!

* Every Goal Works.

### And More!
* Better APWorld Rules to better prevent softlocks. (some settings may cause these rules to not work properly although I have not had a problem yet)
v0.1.0.title: Beta Release!

New (unofficial but I am hopeful) update just dropped. This update primarly fixes some bugs in both the apworld and client.

* Censor password text by @josephwhite in https://github.com/josephwhite/Emerlads-Nodebuster_AP_Mod/pull/19

* Instructions for Godot (4.x) Mod Loader v7.0.1 by @josephwhite in https://github.com/josephwhite/Emerlads-Nodebuster_AP_Mod/pull/20

v0.1.3.description:
## TL;DR

The main highlight are rules based on upgrade connections to help prevent a lot of upgrades being "reachable" in Sphere 0/1 in UT.

### Changed

* Added save file functionality.
    * Connecting to a server will check for save files in `user://` with the same seed and player.
    * Saving will occur more frequently.
* Added additional rules for node connections.
* Added additional rules to seperate easy milestones from milestones that logically need to be grinded.
* Set item classification of `Progressive SpawnRate` from `useful` to `progressive`.
* Disabled auto-unlocking upgrade locations, as save files properly save per slot.

### Fixes

* Save created UUID to file in `user://` and load UUID from said file, ensuring UUIDs are reused for future server locking feature.

## What's Changed
* Validation: Set Upgrade Nodes to checked "continuous" max level by @josephwhite in https://github.com/josephwhite/Emerlads-Nodebuster_AP_Mod/pull/38
* UUID and Save Files in User Folder by @josephwhite in https://github.com/josephwhite/Emerlads-Nodebuster_AP_Mod/pull/45


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/josephwhite/Emerlads-Nodebuster_AP_Mod/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
